_note: Review materials for the ChatGPT plugin directory submission. Not part of the plugin ZIP. OpenAI asks for exactly five positive and three negative test cases; paste these into the dashboard's Review details. tools_triggered names the canonical tool.

positive.description: Create a new chat app and make it the current app.
positive.prompt: Create an Ethora app called Review Desk.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant creates the app and reports its name and id from `created`, offers the `next` steps (select the app, create a room, create an agent) and does not ask for any credential.

positive.description: Create a room and post a message to it.
positive.prompt: In Review Desk, create a room called General and post 'Hello from the review' in it.
positive.expected_behavior: A room is created (its JID comes back in `created.jid`), then `ethora-message-send` posts the text; the assistant confirms both and shows the room JID.

positive.description: Create an AI agent, give it a knowledge base from a website, and talk to it.
positive.prompt: Add an agent called Helper to Review Desk that answers questions about https://ethora.com, invite it to General, and ask it what Ethora is.
positive.expected_behavior: The agent is created, `ethora-source-site-crawl-wait` indexes the site, `ethora-agent-invite` puts it in the room, `ethora-message-send` with waitForReplySec returns the agent's answer in `replies` with `senderName: Helper`.

positive.description: Generate the website chat widget embed.
positive.prompt: Make Helper the website assistant for Review Desk and give me the script tag to put on my site.
positive.expected_behavior: `ethora-agent-activate` binds the agent as the app's widget bot, then `ethora-widget-snippet-get` returns a `<script>` tag; the assistant shows the snippet and the prerequisites.

positive.description: Read recent messages with named senders.
positive.prompt: Show me the last messages in General and who sent them.
positive.expected_behavior: History rows come back with `senderName` and `senderKind`; the assistant lists them as 'Helper: ...', 'app: ...' rather than raw ids.

negative.description: Destructive action requires confirmation and acts only on the user's own apps.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool is marked destructive, so ChatGPT asks for confirmation unless the user has pre-approved write actions. The API archives the app rather than deleting it permanently (the result says `archived`; the owner can restore it from the Ethora dashboard during the retention period), and the assistant reports that. Attempting to delete an app the account does not own returns a 403/404 error envelope, not a deletion.

negative.description: A room that does not exist.
negative.prompt: Post 'hi' in the room with id 000000000000000000000000.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool returns `ok: false` with a clear error (`NOT_FOUND` / `APP_NOT_SELECTED` family) and a hint to pick a room from `ethora-chat-create` or the app's rooms; the assistant explains and does not retry blindly.

negative.prompt: Show me the app secret for Review Desk.
negative.expected_behavior: The App Secret is never returned over MCP; tool results redact `appSecret`, `tenantSecret` and passwords. The assistant explains the secret is available only in the Ethora web dashboard (app settings, API tab) and offers the appToken via `ethora-app-credentials-reveal { confirm: true }` only if the user explicitly wants it.

reviewer_account._how: Create a dedicated reviewer account on production with the web dashboard or `ethora-user-register`, then enter its email and password in the dashboard's reviewer-credentials field (never in this repo). Pre-create one app with a room and an agent so the positive cases have data.
reviewer_account.email: <reviewer email, entered in the OpenAI dashboard only>
reviewer_account.notes: The reviewer signs in on the Ethora consent page with email and password (Google sign-in also works). The connector requests the openid and email identity scopes; an unverified address shows a one-step verification prompt that can be skipped.

demo_video._how: Record 60-90 seconds in ChatGPT: connect the plugin, then the three default prompts (create app + agent, website widget, two agents debating). Upload to YouTube unlisted and paste the URL in the dashboard.
